title: The Barak Record, 2010–2018: What the Scheduling Files Actually Show
evidence_boundary: The source set establishes recurring scheduling, proposed meetings, calendar entries, call coordination and invitations. It does not by itself establish attendance for every proposed event, discussion content, political influence, agency, agreement, legal liability or misconduct.

Groff/Priell coordination of a proposed Barak-Epstein telephone call

corrections.change: Public Barak timeline previously labeled the Barak context as Wed. June 5, 2013 at noon. OCR shows a June 3 4pm appointment with Barak and a June 4 noon lunch with Barak and Bob Kerrey.

open_questions: Which proposed meetings in these scheduling chains were actually attended?
What was discussed in any meeting or call that did occur?
